errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the pie chart sectors are visually arranged in descending order counter-clockwise. In reality, the sectors are not sorted by size. The sequence of percentages counter-clockwise from the largest slice is 31.0%, 4.8%, 16.7%, 21.4%, 26.2%.
